subject.title: Notion number property write rejected via gateway MCP connection; identical call succeeds via separate local MCP session

question: Should this issue remain in evidence-gathering until paired raw tools/call payloads from the gateway and successful local client identify the first divergent boundary?
rationale: Current source and the MCP SDK contract preserve ordinary numeric arguments, so choosing an OpenClaw code change without wire evidence risks fixing the wrong owner layer.

options.title: Require paired wire capture
options.body: Keep the issue open for a redacted gateway-versus-control JSON-RPC capture or minimal recorder reproduction before assigning implementation.

options.title: Sponsor diagnostic instrumentation
options.body: Have an MCP runtime owner add narrowly scoped debug instrumentation that records argument types and redacted request JSON at the SDK boundary.

recommendation.title: Require paired wire capture
recommendation.body: Keep the issue open for a redacted gateway-versus-control JSON-RPC capture or minimal recorder reproduction before assigning implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: The feature history most strongly connects this person to the embedded MCP materialization and runtime boundary where the diagnostic decision belongs.
